materialStory.title: Three fibres. One considered blend.
materialStory.content: Bamboo for a soft feel. Cotton for structure. Spandex for movement. The difference is the blend—not simply swapping one fibre for another.

faqs.q: What is the fabric composition?
faqs.a: 67% Bamboo Viscose, 28% Organic Cotton, and 5% Spandex. Woven for a silky second-skin hand feel with structure and flexible recovery.

faqs.q: How does bamboo compare to ordinary cotton in summer?
faqs.a: Bamboo fibers have microscopic cross-gaps that absorb and evaporate moisture 3x faster than cotton, keeping your skin 2° to 3° cooler in hot and humid weather.

faqs.q: How should I care for it?
faqs.a: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle. Wash with like colors. Avoid chlorine bleach. Hang to air dry in shade or tumble dry on delicate low.

faqs.q: Can I return or exchange if the fit isn't right?
faqs.a: Yes! We offer a 15-day doorstep return and size exchange policy across India on all unwashed, tagged garments.
